title: T2J-BENCH: Benchmarking Coding Agents on Execution-Grounded PyTorch-to-JAX Repository Migration
abstract: arXiv:2605.29054v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Migrating a machine-learning codebase across frameworks--for example from PyTorch to JAX--is a routine but costly engineering task that is fundamentally cross-paradigm: eager, stateful, object-oriented modules must be rewritten as pure, jittable functions over an explicit parameter pytree. We ask whether coding agents can perform such whole-repository migrations correctly, and argue that existing code benchmarks, which grade unit-test pass rates or surface-level similarity to a reference translation, cannot answer this: they neither require the migrated system to \emph{behave} the same nor prevent a JAX reimplementation from faking equivalence by secretly importing PyTorch itself. We introduce T2J-BENCH, a benchmark of 63 whole-repository PyTorch-to-JAX migration tasks spanning 18 model families across both training and serving, where torch-free checkpoint conversion is itself part of the deliverable. T2J-BENCH grades execution

translated_title: T2J-BENCH：基于执行效果的PyTorch到JAX代码仓库迁移编码智能体基准测试
translated_abstract: 将机器学习代码库跨框架迁移——例如从PyTorch迁移到JAX——是一项常规但成本高昂的工程任务，其本质是跨范式的：急切执行的、有状态的、面向对象的模块必须被重写为作用于显式参数pytree的纯函数、可被jit编译的函数。我们探究编码智能体能否正确执行这类整仓库级别的迁移，并指出现有代码基准——它们以单元测试通过率或与参考翻译的表面相似度来评分——无法回答这一问题：它们既不要求迁移后的系统在“行为”上保持一致，也无法防止JAX重新实现通过暗中导入PyTorch本身来伪造等价性。我们提出T2J-BENCH，这是一个包含63个整仓库PyTorch到JAX迁移任务的基准，涵盖18个模型家族，横跨训练与服务两个场景，其中无torch依赖的检查点转换本身就是交付成果的一部分。T2J-BENCH以执行效果为依据进行评分。
tldr: 提出T2J-BENCH基准，包含63个涵盖18个模型家族的整仓库PyTorch到JAX迁移任务，以执行行为一致性和无torch依赖作为核心评价标准，用以真实评估编码智能体进行跨框架代码库迁移的能力。
en_tdlr: T2J-BENCH introduces 63 whole-repository PyTorch-to-JAX migration tasks across 18 model families that evaluate coding agents through execution-grounded equivalence and torch-free deliverables, addressing the blind spots of existing code benchmarks.
